Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities for target CHEMBL1921664. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid, then assays on activities.assay_id, molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, and compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
